info.title: ShopEase Product Catalog Service
info.description:
Product catalog microservice for ShopEase: categories, products and inventory.

Browsing is public. Admin operations need a token from the ShopEase Authentication Service: log in there, select **Authorize** on this page, and paste the access token.

get.description:
Public: no token needed. Returns active categories sorted by name.

With `include_inactive=true` and an ADMIN token, inactive categories are included.

schema.description: Also return inactive categories. Needs an ADMIN token.

delete.description:
Permanently deletes a category that contains no products, active or inactive.

**Policy:** if it still contains products, the request is refused with 409 and nothing changes. Products are never moved or deleted automatically. Either deactivate the category (PUT or PATCH with `is_active: false`), or move its products to another category (PATCH /api/products/{id} with a new `category_id`) and then delete it.

403.description: Inactive user, or ADMIN role required

get.summary: List, search, filter and sort products
get.description:
Public: no token needed. Customers and visitors get only active products in active categories, whatever the filters.

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `search` | Part of the name or SKU, ignoring case |
| `category_id` | Only this category |
| `min_price`, `max_price` | Price range, inclusive, on the normal price |
| `availability` | `in_stock` (stock above 0) or `out_of_stock` (stock 0) |
| `brand` | Exact brand, ignoring case |
| `page`, `page_size` | Page from 1; page size 1 to 100, default 20 |
| `sort_by`, `sort_order` | `name`, `price` or `created_at`; `asc` or `desc`. Default: name, asc |
| `include_inactive` | With an ADMIN token: inactive products too |

Filters combine with AND. A page past the last one returns no items, with the correct `total`. Unknown parameters are refused with 422.

Examples: `?search=mobile`, `?category_id=1`, `?min_price=1000&max_price=5000`, `?page=1&page_size=10`, `?sort_by=price&sort_order=asc`, `?search=phone&availability=in_stock&sort_by=price&sort_order=desc`

post.description:
Required: `category_id` (an existing, active category), `name`, `sku` (unique, ignoring case) and `price`. `discount_price` must be lower than `price`. Prices are decimals with up to two places, sent preferably as strings ("19.99").

`initial_stock` above 0 is recorded as the product's first IN inventory transaction. `stock_quantity` cannot be set directly.

400.description: Body is not a JSON object (malformed JSON, missing, or wrong Content-Type)

403.description: Inactive user, or ADMIN role required

409.description: Another product already has this SKU (letter case is ignored)

422.description: Invalid fields: for example a missing required field, negative price, discount not below price, unknown or inactive category, or a read-only field such as stock_quantity

get.description: Public: no token needed. A missing product, an inactive one, or one in an inactive category returns 404, unless `include_inactive=true` is sent with an ADMIN token.

parameters.name: include_inactive

schema.description: Also return inactive products and products in inactive categories. Needs an ADMIN token.
schema.title: Include Inactive

parameters.description: Also return inactive products and products in inactive categories. Needs an ADMIN token.

401.description: Token invalid or expired, or include_inactive without a token

put.description:
Sets every editable field; all are required. `description`, `discount_price`, `image_url` and `brand` may be null, which clears them. `is_active: false` deactivates the product, `true` reactivates it. Stock is not changed: use /api/inventory.

A new `category_id` must refer to an active category.

400.description: Body is not a JSON object (malformed JSON, missing, or wrong Content-Type)

403.description: Inactive user, or ADMIN role required

409.description: Another product already has this SKU (letter case is ignored)

422.description: Invalid fields: for example a missing required field, negative price, discount not below price, unknown or inactive category, or a read-only field such as stock_quantity

patch.summary: Update some fields of a product (ADMIN)
patch.description: Only the fields sent are changed, for example `{"price": "17.99"}` or `{"is_active": false}`. A `discount_price` or `price` sent alone is checked against the stored value of the other. `stock_quantity` is not accepted: stock changes only through /api/inventory, so that every change is recorded.

400.description: Body is not a JSON object (malformed JSON, missing, or wrong Content-Type)

403.description: Inactive user, or ADMIN role required

409.description: Another product already has this SKU (letter case is ignored)

422.description: Invalid fields: for example a missing required field, negative price, discount not below price, unknown or inactive category, or a read-only field such as stock_quantity

delete.description: Soft delete: sets `is_active` to false and keeps the record, so its inventory history and orders in other ShopEase services still refer to a valid product. The product disappears from public listings at once. Reactivate it with PUT or PATCH and `is_active: true`.

403.description: Inactive user, or ADMIN role required

get.description: Active products whose stock is **at or below** LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD (setting, default 5), lowest stock first. Inactive products are left out: they are not for sale.

schema.title: Response List Low Stock Api Inventory Low Stock Get

403.description: Inactive user, or ADMIN role required

get.description: Current stock_quantity and whether it is at or below LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD. Inactive products are included (stock still exists).

403.description: Inactive user, or ADMIN role required

post.description: Increases stock by `quantity` (a whole number, at least 1) and records an IN transaction with the previous and new stock, the remarks and the time. Both are saved in one database transaction with the product row locked, or neither is.

400.description: Body is not a JSON object (malformed JSON, missing, or wrong Content-Type)

403.description: Inactive user, or ADMIN role required

409.description: Conflicts with existing data or stock levels

post.description: Decreases stock by `quantity` and records an OUT transaction, in one database transaction with the product row locked. If the product has less stock than requested, the answer is 409 `Insufficient stock: N available, M requested` and nothing changes: stock never goes below 0.

400.description: Body is not a JSON object (malformed JSON, missing, or wrong Content-Type)

403.description: Inactive user, or ADMIN role required

409.description: Conflicts with existing data or stock levels

get.description: Every stock movement of the product, newest first, including its initial stock. `total` is the number of transactions; the pages together return all of them (`page_size` up to 100). `transaction_type=IN` or `OUT` limits it to one type.

403.description: Inactive user, or ADMIN role required

ProductCreate.title: ProductCreate
ProductCreate.description:
POST /api/products/. Required: category_id, name, sku, price.

The category must exist and be active. initial_stock, when above 0, is recorded as the
product's first IN inventory transaction. New products are active.

sku.title: Sku
sku.description: Letters, digits and hyphens. Stored upper-case; unique, ignoring case.

discount_price.title: Discount Price
discount_price.description: Must be lower than price; null for no discount

ProductReplace.title: ProductReplace
ProductReplace.description:
PUT /api/products/{id}: the complete new state. Every field must be sent.

description, discount_price, image_url and brand may be null, which clears them.
is_active false deactivates the product. Stock is not part of it.

anyOf.description: Letters, digits and hyphens. Stored upper-case; unique, ignoring case.

ProductUpdate.title: ProductUpdate
ProductUpdate.description:
PATCH /api/products/{id}: only the fields sent are changed.

Sending null clears description, discount_price, image_url or brand. category_id, name, sku,
price and is_active cannot be null. A discount is checked against the stored price when only
one of the two is sent.
